tasks.title: Add environment variable validation
tasks.description: Implement validation to check that NOTION_API_KEY and NOTION_DATABASE_ID are present before initializing the Notion client. Throw descriptive errors if variables are missing.
acceptance_criteria: Script exits gracefully with clear error message if NOTION_API_KEY is missing
Script exits gracefully with clear error message if NOTION_DATABASE_ID is missing
Validation occurs before any API calls are attempted

tasks.title: Add input validation for createTask function
tasks.description: Validate that the title parameter is non-empty and that optional parameters meet expected formats. Return meaningful error messages for invalid inputs.
acceptance_criteria: Title parameter cannot be empty or null
Function returns/throws error with descriptive message for invalid inputs
Notes parameter is properly sanitized if provided

tasks.title: Add input validation for updateTask function
tasks.description: Validate that pageId is a valid Notion page ID format and that status is one of the allowed values. Ensure notes parameter is properly handled.
acceptance_criteria: PageId parameter is validated for correct format
Status parameter is validated against allowed values
Function returns/throws error with descriptive message for invalid inputs

tasks.title: Implement task retrieval functionality
tasks.description: Create a new function to query and retrieve tasks from the Notion database. Support filtering by status, assignee, or other properties.
acceptance_criteria: Function can retrieve all tasks from database
Function supports filtering by status
Function supports filtering by other task properties
Returns tasks in a structured format

tasks.title: Implement task deletion functionality
tasks.description: Create a function to archive or delete tasks from the Notion database by page ID.
acceptance_criteria: Function can archive a task by page ID
Proper error handling for non-existent page IDs
Confirmation message logged on successful deletion

tasks.title: Implement structured logging mechanism
tasks.description: Replace console.log statements with a proper logging library or structured logging approach. Include log levels (info, warn, error) and timestamps.
acceptance_criteria: All console.log replaced with structured logging
Log levels properly categorized (info, warn, error)
Timestamps included in all log entries
Logging library added to dependencies if needed

tasks.title: Create CLI interface for task management
tasks.description: Implement a command-line interface that allows users to create, update, retrieve, and delete tasks via command-line arguments.
acceptance_criteria: CLI supports 'create' command with required arguments
CLI supports 'update' command with page ID and status
CLI supports 'list' command to retrieve tasks
CLI supports 'delete' command with page ID
Help text available via --help flag

tasks.title: Add comprehensive error handling
tasks.description: Enhance error handling throughout the codebase to catch and handle Notion API errors, network errors, and other exceptions gracefully.
acceptance_criteria: All async functions have proper try-catch blocks
API errors are caught and logged with meaningful messages
Network errors are handled with retry logic or clear failure messages
Errors don't expose sensitive information

tasks.title: Create unit tests for core functions
tasks.description: Implement unit tests for createTask, updateTask, and other core functions using a testing framework like Jest or Mocha.
acceptance_criteria: Tests cover createTask function with valid and invalid inputs
Tests cover updateTask function with valid and invalid inputs
Tests mock Notion API calls
Test coverage above 80%
Tests can be run via npm test command

tasks.title: Create integration tests
tasks.description: Implement integration tests that verify the full workflow of creating, updating, and retrieving tasks from Notion (using a test database).
acceptance_criteria: Integration tests use a separate test Notion database
Tests verify end-to-end task creation workflow
Tests verify end-to-end task update workflow
Tests clean up created test data

tasks.title: Create comprehensive documentation
tasks.description: Write detailed documentation covering setup, configuration, usage examples, API reference, and troubleshooting.
acceptance_criteria: README includes setup instructions with prerequisites
README includes environment variable configuration guide
README includes usage examples for all functions
API reference documentation created
Troubleshooting section with common issues

tasks.title: Add task search and filtering capabilities
tasks.description: Enhance task retrieval to support advanced search queries, date range filtering, and sorting options.
acceptance_criteria: Support search by task title keywords
Support filtering by date range
Support sorting by creation date, status, or other properties
Return results in requested sort order

phase_3_interface.description: User interface and enhanced error handling
